Squared-distance gate then rsqrtss.

if (DAT_11cbf070 < d2) rsqrtss(d2) -> inverse length (threshold DAT_11cbf070)
FUN_10eff090(1, this+0x88, 0x3f19999a=0.6f, 1) — 0.6f blend/scale param

functions.purpose: Spawns/binds the render+logic entity for a buff area (region that applies buffs). param_2[0x36],[0x37] = entity id pair; fallback this[0x10]+0xd8/0xdc

class name 'MHBuffArea'; property path '/Libs/EntityProperties/' + record model string; sub-node 'Properties'
default scale local_20 = 0x3f800000 = 1.0f
on failure: releases render node id (this+0x11 = -1), this+0x10=0, returns 0

functions.purpose: 2D paged-array lookup of a pet-support-cat skill info record by skill key/id. Gets the info manager singleton (FindInfoByKey 'CPetSupportCatSkillInfo'), then indexes a paged table.

functions.purpose: Parses an attack hit-condition config block. Reads scalar limits then builds a hash-keyed map of per-attacker override entries (children named 'attacker'), with redundant-hash-collision detection/error.

attacker-name hash: h = 0x4e67c6a7; for each char c: h = h ^ (h*0x20 + (h>>2) + (int)(char)c)
map root at this+0x18 (red-black tree, node key at node+0x10, name ptr at node+0x14); collision => sprintf redundant-hash error
costs: min_time_interval = minimum seconds between hits on same target/part
functions.notes: Authoritative multi-hit limiting: caps how many entities/parts a single attack may hit and the re-hit cooldown. Server must enforce.

same attacker hash: h=0x4e67c6a7; h = h ^ (h*0x20 + (h>>2) + c)
attacker map root at param_1+6 (node key +0x10, name ptr node[5]/+0x14)

functions.purpose: Flowgraph/script node that reads script-table attrs 'SkillId' and 'SkillChanged' (caching their attr ids in this+0x10/+0x11), then triggers a skill change. Routes by id threshold: id<1000000 -> local/player skill path (FUN_1025d5b0/FUN_1025d690); id>=1000000 -> monster skill path (FUN_1025b300/FUN_1025b520 with id-1000000). Emits event 0x93b.

id space split: skillId < 1000000 => player/normal skill; skillId >= 1000000 => monster skill (real id = skillId - 1000000)
if param_2 > 5 early-returns validity flag (param_2 is a mode/level gate)
success path calls FUN_1025d5b0(id) then FUN_1025d690(id) [player] or FUN_1025b300(id-1e6,param_2) then FUN_1025b520(id-1e6,1) [monster]
event id local_54 = 0x93b
functions.notes: Confirms 1,000,000 offset separating player skill ids from monster skill ids. Server should apply the same partition when validating skill ids.

functions.purpose: Master parser for a combat action/state definition. Reads ActionName->type code, weapon holster state, state lists, QTE start states, hittable/non-hittable skill lists, start effects, monster BT event string, failed-except states, and sub-actions.
formulas: ActionName attr -> this+0xc type: ''(default)->3, 'UnHolstered'->1, 'Special'->2, (str@0x11cf5810)->4, (str@0x11cf5814)->5
State lists: 'States'/child 'State' appended to list at this+0x14; 'QTEStartStates' -> list at this+0x64
'HitSkillID' (int>0) and 'HitSkills' (children of CSkillRef {SkillResID,SkillID,Level}) -> hittable-skill list at this+0x1c (node stride 0x14)
'CannotHitSkills' (CSkillRef children) -> list at this+0x24; valid if SkillResID>=1 || SkillID>=1
'StartEffects'/'EffectID'(int>0) -> effect list at this+0x5c (node stride 0xc)
'MonsterBTEvent' string stored at this+0x40 (buffer end this+0x3c)
'FailedExceptState'/'FailedExceptStates' -> state list; 'Actions' children parsed via FUN_10ea6920 (node stride 0x1c)
functions.notes: Authoritative skill<->action interaction rules: which skills this action can/cannot hit, its start effects, and BT event. Server must enforce HitSkills/CannotHitSkills gating and skill-ref matching.
